$comment: §GA-GATE-RATCHET (L-775) — DECLARED DEBT. SHRINK-ONLY.
These gates fail TODAY. They are drift that accumulated while the runner was
broken (L-774: spawnSync could not execute npx on win32, so all 25 reported
FAILED with no output and the suite was never wired into CI).
RULES:
1. A gate NOT on this list that fails is a REGRESSION and blocks CI.
2. A gate ON this list that starts PASSING is also a failure — remove its
line in the same commit that fixes it. Paid debt must leave the ledger,
or this file rots into a list of things that are secretly fine.
3. NOTHING may be ADDED here without an explicit founder/architect decision.
Adding a line is choosing to ship a known contract violation.
Baselined 2026-08-08 from the first successful run of the suite:
9 passing / 16 failing. Every removal below is real progress toward C01 §5,
which states all gates MUST pass before a PR merges — currently untrue.
2026-08-09 · §FIX-GATE-NEEDS-RIPGREP (L-811) — REMOVED check-three-imports.ts.
It was never failing on merit. It shelled out to `rg`, which is not a declared
dependency and which ci.yml never installed, so it died with `spawnSync rg
ENOENT` and the runner recorded that crash as the declared failure. Rewritten
on a Node-native scanner it PASSES: 0 direct 'three' imports outside
packages/renderer-three across 6,261 files. P2 was clean the whole time and
nobody could see it.
check-cast-count.ts and check-raf-count.ts had the SAME crash and stay on the
ledger — but now for real reasons, measured for the first time:
• raf-count:  5 files own requestAnimationFrame, target 1. The 4 extra are
livingGraphSelection, RendererSwapOverlay, BimWorld,
RenderingPipelineCoordinator. HARD_FAIL stays at 1; the ceiling was NOT
raised to accommodate them.
• cast-count: 20 `(window as any)` in apps/editor/src/engine (strict scope,
ceiling 0, untouched) and 215 repo-wide on a new second ratchet.
2026-08-10 · §RAF-GATE-COMMENT-BLIND — REMOVED check-raf-count.ts. The 4
extra 'owners' above were never rAF calls: all four matches were COMMENT
lines (three of them doc comments asserting P3 compliance). With comment
lines filtered before counting (lib/rafOwners.ts, the same idiom as the P6
gate) the measured owner count is exactly 1 — RafAdapter.ts, the canonical
owner. P3 had already converged; the gate was counting sentences. HARD_FAIL
unchanged at 1. Convergence boolean #3 now imports the SAME count instead of
spawning a nonexistent script and reporting its failure as a pass.
